description: Connects a domain or subdomain to a Saxum Commerce shop with an A record: a TXT record that proves the domain belongs to the shop, the A record that routes it to Saxum's hosting and, when the hosting provider asks for it, its verification TXT record.
variableDescription: proof: the shop's ownership value (after saxum-commerce=); ip: the hosting IPv4 address; vercel: the hosting provider's verification value (after vc-domain-verify=, group vercel).
